title: Mass-driver packet launch and catch

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 444882 (0x0006c9d2), HLP file offset 116679 (0x0001c7c7), topic 51 'Mass Driver Basics'
TOPICPOS 1033026 (0x000fc342), HLP file offset 262455 (0x00040137), topic 122 'Flinging Mass Packets'
TOPICPOS 2261577 (0x00228249), HLP file offset 569406 (0x0008b03e), topic 343 'Alternate Reality Races'

setup.baseline: Two planets, one with a mass driver and one with an equal/greater or lesser catcher.
setup.variable: Driver rating, packet speed and target.

procedure: Target the driver and build a packet.
Record launch year, first-year travel, arrival year and decay.
Catch with equal/greater and lesser/no driver; record loss and damage.
Test speeds above the rated speed and Packet Physics/Interstellar Traveller modifiers.

documented: A packet is caught safely only by a driver of equal or greater capacity; otherwise some or all colonists/installations are destroyed and 2/3 of minerals are lost on an uninhabited impact (documented-only).
Below-rated speeds can be caught by lesser drivers; above-rated speeds are unstable and decay 10/20/50% per warp level (documented-only).
Packets travel half the normal distance in their first year (documented-only).

unresolved: Exact damage, catch capacity and packet cost formulas are unknown.
Trait-specific decay/efficiency modifiers need runtime measurement.
